purpose: diagnose whether the deployed boss-native PI Agent and veRL PI rollout paths produce practically compatible outcome distributions; this is not a strict identical-runtime A/B

sampling.source: PI CLI omits sampling overrides; values come from the frozen Step120 generation_config.json and are explicitly mirrored in veRL

effective_sampling_audit.pi_agent: the PI runner and client omit temperature/top-p/top-k; the Step120 vLLM server generation_config supplies temperature=1.0, top_p=0.95, top_k=20, do_sample=true
effective_sampling_audit.verl_rollout: the parity batch sets validate=true and do_sample=true; installed AgentLoopManager selects val_kwargs temperature=1.0, top_p=0.95, top_k=20 instead of the ordinary validation default temperature=0

matched_core_variables: the same 10 evaluation-only prompts and hidden final-result labels
four tool schemas and qwen3_coder parsing
all eight trajectories retained without Fastest-K

known_native_runtime_differences.per_assistant_request_limit: PI maxTokens=8192; veRL dynamically permits the remaining context up to the 45056-token response budget
known_native_runtime_differences.context_management: PI performs native compaction/retry; veRL uses continuous-token accumulation without the same PI compactor
known_native_runtime_differences.termination: PI is bounded by an external per-trajectory wall timeout; veRL has explicit 26 assistant / 25 user turns and no matched per-trajectory wall timeout in this standalone run
known_native_runtime_differences.concurrency: PI first pass used 32 client workers; veRL used 16 agent workers
known_native_runtime_differences.tool_runtime: the schemas and sandbox assets are aligned, but native PI tools and project veRL tool wrappers are different implementations
known_native_runtime_differences.request_rng_pairing: both arms sampled stochastically, but requests were not paired to identical random seeds

parity_smoke_gates.complete_shape: 10 tasks x 8 samples in both arms

decision_policy.mixed: diagnostic evidence only; a parity pass licenses applying the same screen to a separate strict-semantically-approved training pool, never these val20 prompts
decision_policy.all_correct: exclude from that optimizer update; retain for evaluation and anti-regression
decision_policy.all_wrong: exclude from that optimizer update; retain for correction SFT, curriculum, or future rescreen

limitations: 10x8 is an engineering smoke test, not proof of statistical equivalence
the experiment compares the two deployed execution paths; runtime-native token, compaction, timeout, concurrency and tool implementations are not identical
the selected val20 is alignment-reviewed under the older contract, not yet approved by the later strict instruction-gold-SQL semantic audit
diagnostic trajectories are never reused directly in a training update
